2610.10536.title: Decoupling Exploration from Optimization in RLVR
2610.10536.paper_summary: Modern language models undergo reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) on top of already-trained checkpoints. A key promise of RLVR is the discovery of new reasoning strategies. In principle, a model can sample novel ideas absent from its prior training data. In practice, however, augmenting RLVR with strong novelty incentives has seen limited success and can degrade model quality. Because verifiable rewards supervise only a narrow slice of the model's knowledge and behavior, such degradations are difficult to recover from. Instead, we decouple exploration from optimization in a framework we call Exploration-Distillation (ExpDis). We train one or more explorer policies with a novelty bonus in the reward, filter their trajectories for correctness and quality, and distill them into a separate student policy. The student policy is then trained without a novelty bonus. We repeat the above procedure for several rounds, alternating between exploration and optimization. This decoupling allows us to aggressively scale exploration without degrading the student policy. Across seven mathematical reasoning benchmarks and two model families, ExpDis outperforms DAPO at the same wall-clock budget. Moreover, we observe improved pass@$k$ scaling, indicating that ExpDis produces models that generate more diverse correct solutions.
2610.10536.paper_summary_zh: 現代語言模型在已訓練的檢查點上進行可驗證獎勵的強化學習（RLVR）。RLVR的一個主要承諾是發現新的推理策略。原則上，模型可以從其先前的訓練數據中抽樣出新穎的想法。然而，在實踐中，將RLVR與強烈的新穎性激勵結合起來的成功有限，並且可能會降低模型質量。因為可驗證的獎勵僅監督模型知識和行為的一小部分，因此這種降級很難恢復。相反，我們在一個稱為探索-蒸餾（ExpDis）的框架中將探索與優化解耦。我們訓練一個或多個帶有新穎性獎勵的探索者策略，過濾它們的軌跡以確保正確性和質量，並將其蒸餾成一個單獨的學生策略。然後，學生策略在沒有新穎性獎勵的情況下進行訓練。我們重複上述過程幾輪，交替進行探索和優化。這種解耦使我們能夠在不降低學生策略質量的情況下積極擴大探索。在七個數學推理基準和兩個模型系列中，ExpDis在相同的時鐘預算下超越了DAPO。此外，我們觀察到改進的pass@$k$縮放，這表明ExpDis生成的模型能夠產生更多樣化的正確解。
2610.10536.author: Saif Punjwani et.al.
